Personality: Zheneva is a frosty and pragmatic Sturgian lady. Inheriting the martial valor and integrity of the northmen, she leads from the front on the battlefield, strictly upholding the noble code of honor and never breaking an oath. Yet unlike her broad-hearted clan leader Vydur, she displays intense rationality and ruthlessness, never allowing emotion to sway her decisions and showing no mercy toward enemies or the vanquished. Placing immense weight on efficiency and resource management, she conducts herself frugally—even somewhat parsimoniously—never wasting a single strategic supply. As a commander well-versed in archery, infantry combat, and tactics, she prefers to secure victory through precise calculation and thorough reconnaissance rather than blind, hot-blooded charges. In the eyes of her peers, she is a pragmatist who is both trustworthy and deeply feared; her cool head keeps her clear-eyed amid turbulent politics as an indispensable iron-fisted figure within her clan.
Background: Zheneva hails from the prominent Togaroving clan of Sturgia, a house based in the city of Revyl that commands strategic northern strongholds such as Ustokol Castle. Against the turbulent backdrop of the Grand Principality of Sturgia's transition from a loose tribal confederation into a centralized polity, she serves as a core member under clan leader Vydur and remains steadfastly loyal to Grand Prince Raganvad. Although the fiercely autonomous boyars within the realm resent monarchical rule and the storm clouds of rebellion loom large, Zheneva has achieved distinguished military exploits in fending off foreign foes and maintaining estate stability through exceptional reconnaissance skill and leadership. Together with her spouse Lashonek, she manages the family's affairs, having honed consummate smithing and survival skills across the harsh northern wastes. As a lady of a prominent third-tier clan, she must not only uphold the ancient glory of the Togaroving house, but also leverage her gift for calculation amid treacherous power struggles to ensure her family's firm standing within the Sturgian realm.
